passages.provision_quote: Beginning in 2026, aT ANY VOTING LOCATION THE VOTER MAY CHOOSE TO PROVIDE IDENTIFICATION WHEN PRESENTING THE VOTER'S MAILED EARLY BALLOT, AND IF SO THE ELECTION OFFICIAL SHALL:
passages.note: The chaptered text amends polling places, sample ballots, early ballot requests, signature verification, canvass deadlines, recounts and the 2024 primary date, so the identification clause is one part of many.

rows.reasoning: The only instrument is HB 2785 (2024), an omnibus election act amending sixteen statutes on polling places, sample ballots, signature verification, canvassing, recounts and the primary date, so Kolodin's prime sponsorship and his Aye vote are multi-subject and no passage survives to a chair. Its identification clause makes ID at a voting location a voter's option when handing in a mailed early ballot ("THE VOTER MAY CHOOSE TO PROVIDE IDENTIFICATION WHEN PRESENTING THE VOTER'S MAILED EARLY BALLOT"), which is neither "Require photo ID in person and an ID number on every mail ballot" nor "Require documentary proof of citizenship to register to vote"; the in-person list in section 16-579 keeps its two-non-photo-document route unchanged. No statement of his ties the act to any identification clause, so nothing establishes a rung.
